strategy_catalog.name: Enlarged Tile Sizes - Anti Patterns
strategy_catalog.natural_language: Increase BLOCK_M, BLOCK_N, and BASE_K from 64 to 128. Larger tile sizes amortize loop overhead, improve L0A/L0B utilization from 25% to 50%, and reduce the number of Mmad iterations per tile.

constraints: BLOCK_M must be multiple of C0 (=16 for fp16)
BLOCK_N must be multiple of C0
BASE_K must be multiple of C0

anti_patterns.pattern: Increase tile sizes without checking L1 budget
anti_patterns.reason: For dim=512, Q_buf = 128*512*2 = 128KB, KV_buf = 128KB, P_buf = 64KB, total ~384KB, may overflow L1 512KB limit
anti_patterns.correct_approach: Check dim first: if dim >= 512, keep BLOCK_M=64 or reduce to 96

anti_patterns.reason: L0A/L0B require 512Byte alignment, C0=16 for fp16. Non-multiple causes alignment error
anti_patterns.correct_approach: Always use BLOCK_M % C0 == 0, BLOCK_N % C0 == 0

anti_patterns.reason: VEC2_M_CHUNK mismatch with BLOCK_M causes inefficient row processing
anti_patterns.correct_approach: Set VEC2_M_CHUNK = BLOCK_M or BLOCK_M/2 for optimal vectorization

precautions: Verify L1 buffer budget before changing tile sizes
Ensure all tile size parameters are C0-aligned
Check subBlockNum compatibility: BLOCK_M must be divisible by subBlockNum
Monitor L0A/L0B utilization metrics after tile size change
